test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

When will the new laws be implemented by the government?

options.text: When will the government implement the new laws?
When has the government implemented the new laws?
When did the government implement the new laws?
When would the government implement the new laws?

solution:
**The correct answer is:** *When will the government implement the new laws?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the **Future**** **Simple tense and we need to change it into the **active **form.
 
• The Future Simple in the passive voice has the following form: **Question Word + will/ shall + Object + be + V3 + by + Subject?__**
 
• The Future Simple in the active voice has the following form: **__Question Word + will/shall + Subject + V1 + Object?__**
 __
 
• Passive: *When shall we be called by Teena?*
 
• Active: *When will Teena call us?*
 
 
 
• In the active voice of Future Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *When will the government implement the new laws?*
